legal.privacy.body:
{business} respects your privacy. This policy explains which personal information the app collects, why, and what you can do about it.

We collect the details you give us (your name, email address, phone number and delivery addresses), the plans, photos and designs you upload, and the messages you exchange with {business} about your orders.

We use this information to prepare estimates and quotes, to produce and deliver your furniture, to send you updates about your orders by email, SMS, WhatsApp or push notification, and to keep the service secure.

Your information is visible to the {business} team members who work on your orders. We share it with service providers only as far as needed to run the app (for example message delivery and file storage), and never sell it.

We keep your information for as long as your account is active and as long as the law requires us to keep order and tax records. You can ask {business} to correct, export or delete your data at any time.

The app uses cookies that are needed to keep you signed in and to remember your appearance setting. It does not use advertising trackers.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.terms.body:
These terms govern your use of the {business} app and the custom furniture services we provide through it. By creating an account or placing an order you accept them.

You are responsible for the accuracy of the plans, measurements and photos you upload. Estimates and quotes are based on that information. {business} may revise a quote when the details turn out to differ from what was provided.

A quote becomes an order only when you accept it. Once production has started, changes and cancellations may be limited or charged, as described in the quote you accepted.

Designs, drawings and renderings created in the app are provided for planning your furniture and may not be resold or reused for other projects without the written consent of {business}.

The app is provided as is. {business} is not liable for losses that result from decisions made on estimates alone, nor for service interruptions outside its control.

{business} may update these terms from time to time. Continuing to use the app after a change means you accept the updated terms. If you have questions, contact {business} using the details at the bottom of this page.
